_document_title: GridSenpAI Canonical Facility Model (derived from planner_required_fields)
_document_purpose: Derived support schema describing the governed canonical-state layers, planner field groupings, and planner-packet structures used by GridSenpAI. planner_required_fields remains the authoritative source contract; this file is a derived support schema.
_design_notes: planner_required_fields is the authoritative planner field contract.
This canonical schema is a derived support artifact for canonical-state structure, resolution-ledger layering, and planner-packet organization.
Accepted values, alternatives/conflicts, backlog, and packet sections should remain aligned to the planner registry.
This file is not a competing source of truth for field coverage.

candidate_evidence_layer.description: All candidate evidence items collected from ingestion, OCR/parsing, extraction, retrieval, vendor references, official sources, and applicant answers.

resolved_field_layer.description: Best-supported accepted value per planner field after deterministic adjudication.

alternatives_and_conflicts_layer.description: Runner-up values, rejected candidates, preserved conflicts, and planner-review flags.

interview_backlog_layer.description: Targeted applicant follow-up items driven by unresolved, low-confidence, or materially conflicting planner fields.

planner_export_layer.description: Planner-facing packet structures derived from the resolution ledger.

normalization_governance.missing_field_policy: Missing or weak fields remain explicit as unresolved, review_required, or confirmation-needed; they are not silently fabricated.
normalization_governance.conflict_policy: Materially conflicting values must be preserved and surfaced in the alternatives/conflicts layer until resolved.
